The staff is professional, the space is cozy, and the food...is incredible.
I was impressed that in such a small space, they were able to fit so many people and not make it seem very cramped.
The space was larger than I expected and the space between tables was enough to feel as if you weren't sitting on top of each other.
In fact it was probably ideally crowded for a place so small.
